These graphs show the pH of ocean surface waters at four long-running measurement sites around the world. Historical observations are from 1983 through 2022, though some sites started later and ended earlier. These observations show seasonal fluctuations within each year. Modeled projections for four different climate scenarios are from 2015 through 2100. Historical model outputs are shown from 1950 to 2014. Modeled outputs are smoothed using an 11-year moving average. Shaded bands show the range of monthly values from different climate models. Select items in the legend to toggle them on or off.
